content.short: Compass Art helps users spot collections before they go mainstream.
content.description: Compass Art is an analytics tool focused on NFT data and trends. It provides a range of resources to help users make informed buying and selling decisions, and to identify popular collections and new mints. Developers can access NFT data and analytics to spot trending trades and market opportunities across diverse collections. Compass Art also offers a listing feed, allowing users to discover underrated NFTs before they gain mainstream attention.
